balls.text: moves outside off, tries to paddle sweep but can't connect .. keeper collects
backs away to slice the full delivery to deep point
swings it to wide midwicket region for couple of runs
crashes a straight drive ... deflected by the bowler on to the stumps and it goes towards long-on ... they take off for the second run . but they can't complete the run. Venugopal rao is run out
moves outside leg and drives to sweeper cover
full delivery ... dragged through mid-on
length delivery that goes across the batsman .. moves past the edge
banged in short, mistimes the pull to midwicket
Holes out this time to mid-off .. Rohit moves outside leg stump and goes for the lofted hit and skies it up straight towards mid-off
Neat. Rohit moves outside leg stump and slashes the length delivery over point. Superbly played.
swings to the deep midwicket for couple of runs
banged in short outside off stump, cut to deep point
Super hit. Ala Owais Shah. He leaned forward and swatted it high over backward square-leg
length delivery around off stump, jabbed to the off side
slower one, goes for the pull shot and misses
full in length, clears the front foot and lifts it over long-on... runs coming in at a flood now
another slower one, pushed to long-off
slower one, full and around the off stump line, edges it to fine-leg
Crashed! Suman thrashes the length delivery flat over long-off. He just knifed through the line
moves outside leg and runs it to third man
full and outside off stump, Rohit clears the front leg and slices it to point boundary
driven straight to cover
Maximum. Short and going down leg side, Rohit Sharma pulls it away over backward square-leg boundary.
moves outside leg stump and thrashes the full toss to long-on
banged in short, goes for the pull but again can't connect
leans forward to turn it to fine-leg
leans forward to push it to cover
stays back to work it to midwicket .. throw misses the stumps at non-striker's end and rolls away to sweeper cover
gets forward to drive on the up past the bowler
bouncer on the off stump line, Suman is late on the pull, beaten for pace and bounce but gets a lucky top edge over the keeper
banged in short, at the body, fended away to fine-leg
kicks up from short of length, goes for the pull, misses and is struck on the body
full in length and outside off, dabbed to third man
from outside off stump, run down to third man
sprays it to the pads and Rohit plays a neat leg glance to collect a boundary
slower one, outside off, guided to backward point
slower one, tapped to the on side
backs away to knife the short-of-length on the up and through the line to long-off boundary
short in length, around off stump line, jabbed to short cover
pushes this to the midwicket
backs away to the on side and goes for the slog-pull but miscues it off the outer edge .. a dolly to AB at short cover
slower one outside off stump, Rohit waits for the ball to arrive before opening the bat-face to run it to third man
walks down the track and jabs it away in the end
gos for the slog and connects well .. the ball crashes in to the wide midwicket boundary
backs away to jab a full delivery to the on side
banged in short, pulled away
backs away to cut to deep cover
turns in to the middle, eased to square-leg
worked to square-leg for a single
Bosh! a tad fuller and Symonds muscles it to the straight boundary. That was whacked.
stays back, creates room and thrashes it .. a fore-hand fierce flat-batted thrash past the non-striker!
skips down the track and jabs it to the off side
but he plays a nice-looking square drive to make up for the horrible shot previous ball. It's a short of length delivery outside off and Rohit leans back to caress it superbly past backward point
goes for an awful pull to a delivery well outside off and is beaten
short in length on the middle stump line, pushed to left of short midwicket
cuts in towards off and middle, worked to short midwicket
short in length, slashed down to third man
full in length around off stump line, eased past the bowler
short in length and outside off stump, Symonds rocks back to cut it to point boundary
stays back to punch it to long-on
slow off break outside off, defended to the on side
bounces in from outside off stump, Gibbs goes for the square cut but ends up slashing it to left of backward point where Moises takes a good diving catch
stays back to tap the off break to square-leg
kicks up from short of length, jabbed away to point
outside off stump, run down to third man
leans forward t odrive uppishly and AB, again, dives forward but can't reach the ball
another run out chance .. Again AB the man with the throw.. this time Symonds was just short off the crease ..

run out chance missed pushed towards extra cover and gets across for a quick single. AB swoops in and flicks a throw at non-striker's end but misses. Gibbs would have been run out ,.. he was not even in the frame
Just over long-off. Full delivery around off stump line and Gibbs lofts it over long-off .. over the leaping fielder
backs away to drill to deep cover
squeezes this to the off side
gets forward to work it to midwicket
moves in towards off and middle, defended to the off side
skids low .. Symonds crouches to keep it out
Top shot. He didn't leave the crease, just leaned forward, reached the flighted delivery and lifted it over long-on
around the off stump line, eased to the off side
leans forward to drive uppishly towards long-off
googly on the middle stump line, pushed down to long-on
short in length around off stump, punched to long-off
quickish delivery, straightening on the middle stump line, poked away to the on side
on the middle stump line, stabbed to the on side
around the off stump line, turned to vacant midwicket region
leans well forward to defend cautiously to the on side
skids in towards middle and leg, dabbed to midwicket
the quickish slider on middle and leg, turned to the on side
slides in from outside off, jabbed to point

Gilly combusts. It was a flighted delivery outside leg stump line and Gilchrist tries to whip flick it over square-leg but edges a dolly to the off side .. and the keeper settles under it. What a huge wicket. Fine googly though
goes for the sweep and drags it behind to square-leg boundary.
Thrash! That good old slog sweep. He went down on his knee to scythe .. up and over she flew over wide midwicket boundary
slider .. skids away from outside off, Gilly is beaten, trying to cut it
the leggie skids the ball in towards the off stump, pushed out back down the track
stays back to clip the short-of-length delivery to deep square-leg
on the off stump line, tapped to the on side
Whack! The off spinner pushes it flat outside off but Gilly slog-sweeps it hard to midwicket boundary
fetches it from around the off stump line and sweeps it really hard to backward square-leg boundary
spins in to the middle and leg, worked to square-leg
leans forward to push the off break to the on side
again pushed through outside leg, worked to backward square-leg
unfurls the sweep shot and drags it to fine-leg boundary. It was a full delivery outside leg stump
flighted around off stump line, driven to long-off
moves down the track and drags it through mid-on
leans forward to push to short extra cover
leans forward to tap it to the on side
length delivery on the leg stump line, pushes it out to short midwicket
Nannes continues to bowl full and he continues to suffer. Another full pitched delivery and Gibbs caresses it straight between the bowler and the umpire. He just pushed it .. lovely timing
really full again, hit to the off side
Whiplashed! It was full and outside off stump, Gibbs leans across to lash it over point
What a fabulous hit. He just leaned forward to lift very very nonchalantly a length delivery high over long-off. Superbly done
angling away from Gibbs who is beaten, as he pokes at it
flighted on leg and middle, eased to the on side
leans forward to tap it to the off side

And this time the googly works. Mishra takes out Mishra. This time Monish went for a big heave but the ball broke back in to crash into the off stump. He was lucky to survive a plausible shout for lbw the previous time but he is gone now
c harges down the track and tries to whip a flighted delivery outside leg stump to midwicket, misses and the ball runs off the edge
worked to the on side. Free hit coming up

Almost done in by the googly. It broke back in, Monish didn't pick it and was struck on the pad in front of middle. Bowden must reckon it would have turned down leg.. replays suggest it would have hit the middle stump!
leans forward to drive the leggie to short cover
full and straight, just short of the blockhole .. nothing much could be done with it .. Deccan have won a thrilling game
really full again, pushed to long-on for a single
almost yorker length, just outside leg, squeezed to the on side ..
full delivery around off stump, driven to cover for a single
Ladda is run out Vaas is again in thick of the action. It was pushed to the off side of the pitch, say towards short mid-off.. Vaas picks, turns and fires a direct hit at the non-striker's end
Full, straight and it moves past the attempted slog over midwicket and crashes into middle and leg. Vaas, as ever, gently jogs towards the keeper
really full delivery, pushed down to long-on .. 14 from 6 balls. Great over from Symonds under pressure
drives this one to long-off
saves the hat trick by pushing the full length delivery to the off side

Another wicket! It was a length delivery just outside off, Mishra tries to play the late cut but too risky to play first-ball and edges it to Gilly who holds on . And the game continues to throw up more drama

What a catch by Symonds.. Dk had hit an uppish straight drive well to the right of Symonds who lunged to his right with a outstretched right hand and plucks it off thin air! He then gives DK a quiet send-off.. points to the dressing room. Another twist in the tale. Fine innings from DK.
slightly short in length, DK had moved away from the stump,s created his own room and plays a lovely square cut to the boundary
stays back to push this to cover point
This is some over... DK is having a crack at the young Rahul Sharma... This one was pushed outside off stump and Dk cuts it hard to point boundary
Bravo! DK goes for another slog sweep and connect again. Maximum! Gilly rushes to have a chat with the bowler. The crowd are loving it.
This time the slog sweep works and the ball flies to the midwicket boundary
moves outside leg stump, goes for the slog sweep, misses and the ball goes past the leg stump and Gilly doesn't stop it cleanly
stays back to work it to midwicket for a single ..
full in length around off stump line, pushed down to long-on
jabs it to short fine-leg region. Just three runs so far.
goes for the big slog across the line but fails to connect. Gilly, standing up to the stumps, takes off the bails
outside off stump, stabbed to backward point ..
pushes it down the leg side... Gilly takes the bails off...  was the back foot on the line .. or was some part behind the line ..
Caught by RP! Much fun! It was a length delivery on the stumps, Moises slices the intended lofted hit to RP .. dolly of a catch this time

dropped by RP at backward point. DK had sliced the intended big hit ... RP moved to his right, didn't judge the ball at all, he had to move forward but he didn't , lunges out at the end but cant' reach
stays back to work it to long-leg….
just outside off stump, Moises plays a fine cut shot to the backward point boundary
It was pushed towards midwicket  and they get across for a quick single .. it was refered upstairs but Moises was in
The slog sweep gets the crowd going. DK went down on his knee, cleared the front foot and swings it over midwicket boundary
on the off stump line, pushed through covers
backs away to force the delivery from middle and off line to right of sweeper cover
flighted around off stump and Moises plays a fine square -drive to pick up another valuable boundary.
Manha's slog takes the ball towards wide long-on .. Suman rushes forward from the deep and lunges out at the last minute to a take a good catch under pressure
Finally, a boundary for Delhi. He charged out and plays a neat sliced square drive over point
almost a run out. DK squeezes it to the off side and rushes across. Gilly flicks the gloves off and fires a throw at the non-striker's end . DK dives to get back in the crease
gets forward to drive to long-off
gets forward to ping long-on
short in length, cut away to backward point .. throw goes wide of the stumps and they take the run
full in length and outside off, mistimes to mid-on
fullish on the legs, flicked away to deep square-leg region
short and outside off, cut away to sweeper cover
the intended whip to the on side to third man
picks a single with a push to mid-=on
goes back to push it back to the bowler
pushed to coverse
Would you believe it, he has missed the full toss... low dipping full toss, AB goes for the slog sweep and misses it completely! What a mess!
moves towards the off stump to slice it to deep cover
gets forward to drive the length delivery to mid-off
blasted away. Full pitched outside off and DK plays a neat cover drive
length delivery moving away from DK who tries to steer it to third man very late but can't connect
short in length and outside off, cut away to sweeper cover
delivery on the middle and leg, flicked through midwicket
leans forward to ping deep cover
goes for the big slog sweep but edges it over Gilly
on the leg stump line, nudged to short fine-leg for a quick single
leans forward to drive to deep cover
warner is run out cut to backward point and they set off for the risky single .. RP fires the throw to Gilly who breaks the stumps with Warner out of the way
full delivery, pushed back to the bowler
Dropped in short, pulled away to deep midwicket
Short in length around off, pushed to cover
Floats the off break on the leg stump line, driven away through the on side
Length delivery on the middle stump line, worked through midwicket
on the middle and leg, dabbed to midwicket
length delivery on middle and off, pushed past non striker
length delivery around off stump line, punched to long-off
short in length, on the middle, punched to deep cover
turned wide of midwicket for two runs.. very close second run .. he just about drags the bat back inside the crease
slider outside off, dragged down to longon
on the middle stump line, dabbed past midwicket
lands it on a length, straightens on the middle, worked to vacant midwicket
pushed out to cover for a single
stays back to cut to right of sweeper cover
What a way to start your ipl. Poor fella. Starts with a long hop. Blink. A member of crowd throws the ball back from the midwicket stand. Warner had pulled it high and over
low dipping full toss, pushed back to the bowler
pushes this one back to Rohit
Nicely done. He moved down the track, stayed beside the line of the delivery and lifted it inside-out over extra cover
skips down the track and whips to Venugopal rao at deep midwicket
on the middle, worked to midwicket
it's a delivery outside leg stump, Warner goers right back and squeezes it to short fine-leg region
good delivery ,cutting in, towards middle and leg, Warner was trying to stay adjacent and knife it through off and edges it to backward square-leg region
on a length, around off stump line, jabbed away towards mid-off but he rushes across for a quick single
fullish outside off, driven straight to cover
slow off cutter  around the middle stump line, eased to mid-off
Typical AB square cut. He bent his back knee, leaned forward to play a lofted square drive in his inimitable fashion over point. he almost flat bats it , slices it over
outside off stump, square driven to point region

Pragyan Ojha takes the big wicket. Sehwag moved outside leg and tried to drive inside out over extra cover but ended up lifting it towards long-off and Gibbs rushes in to take a good low catch, lunging forward. Ojha has bowled a gem of a over so far.
turns away from sehwag who goes for a slog sweep but cant' connect
yorker on the middle and off, squeezed to short third man
steps out , almost yorks himself, just about manages to dig it out
stays back, clears the front foot and flats bats from outside off past the non striker
worked to midwicket where Symonds stops
drills this full pitched delivery to long-on
really full delivery, following Warner who was trying to move to leg side.. on driven through midwicket
slow off cutter and Sehwag was backing away for the big hit and ends up dragging it off the inner edge past midwicket
almost an yorker on middle stump line, dug back to Vaas
slower off cutter, Sehwag pushes his first delivery to midwicket
a dot ball. Stop the press. Warner drives to cover
Immense fun. He thrashes the full delivery to long-on boundary. RP is bowling lot of rubbish - right in the slot stuff and Warner is tearing him apart
Whoa! A flat crowdkiller. It flew flat over point. In the slot and outside off and Warner flat-batted it over point. Gem!
fetches another length delivery from outside off and drags it to midwicket
RP hurls another on in the slot and Warner slices this to long-off boundary.
Violence! He went down on his knee and crashed the full length delivery over long-on.
clears the front leg and slogs it towards deep midwicket
Edged past slips. Full and swinging away from Warner who wants to drive it over mid-on but gets a fat edge. Vaas holds his head
fuller, outside off and Warner goes for the big lofted drive, doesn't quite time it well as it swings away and slices it over extra cover
around the off stump line, pushes it out cautiously to the off side
another one full and leaving away late, squeezed to backward point
lovely delivery shaping away late, moving away from Warner who is beaten, pushing inside the line
